items.title: Starknet opens vote on potential Ethereum L2 exit over quantum risks
items.summary: Starknet is asking STRK holders whether to explore becoming an independent layer-1 blockchain to reduce its dependence on Ethereum’s quantum-security upgrade timeline.

items.title: Can crypto users trust the supply chain behind hardware wallets?
items.summary: Ledger hardware wallet implants have renewed scrutiny of the middlemen handling devices before they reach buyers, even through authorized sellers.

items.title: EasyA hits $1.1 billion valuation, targets 2027 public listing and tokenized shares
items.summary: The blockchain and AI developer platform has completed two years of audits and wants its shares available onchain from the first day of trading.

items.title: SequenceHash: multihashing for the rest of us
items.summary: Multihashing is one of those cryptographic tasks that’s easy not to think about too much. This is unfortunate, because multihashing is a common stumbling point when cryptographers try to use hashes. As part of our goal to “fix software, not bugs,” Trail of Bits is introducing Seq

items.title: Under pressure Ledger unveils plan to turn its crypto hardware wallet into a smartphone
items.summary: Ledger’s Atom will run apps like WhatsApp and Instragram and let users switch between smartphone functions and a protected mode for managing digital assets.

items.title: Bitcoin, copper, stocks, yields all fall; gold rises
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 15, 2026

items.title: Bitcoin holds above $80,000 as Asian stock rout drags altcoins lower
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to just above $80,000 as South Korea’s Kospi plunged 8%, while the CoinDesk 80 fell 2.2% and all but six CoinDesk 100 members declined.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trades near $81,000 as South Korea's chip-heavy Kospi continues to plunge
items.summary: Jitters across equity markets are sending money into fixed income, with Western bond markets rallying strongly on Thursday.

items.title: Hyperliquid founder wants U.S. oversight of trading platforms, not his blockchain
items.summary: Jeff Yan told Bloomberg that U.S. regulatory oversight should apply to the firms using the blockchain, not to the underlying network itself.

items.title: Australia’s financial watchdog seeks stiffer rules for crypto exchanges ahead of licensing deadline
items.summary: The country’s regulator, ASIC, has proposed tougher rules to protect users’ digital assets, crypto trading and to safeguard the country’s financial stability.

items.title: Hex founder Richard Heart arrested in Istanbul, Turkish media report
items.summary: Police reportedly seized $4 million in cash and 64 luxury watches during a raid on the crypto founder's Istanbul residence.

items.title: BlackRock's Fink names a U.S. recession trigger, sounds alarm over $40 trillion national debt
items.summary: BlackRock's CEO says "a moratorium of some sort" on data center buildouts would put the U.S. in a recession.

items.title: Nearly $1 billion in crypto bets liquidated as bitcoin, ether and XRP slide
items.summary: Ether accounted for nearly 60% of the forced closures across the two largest cryptocurrencies, falling roughly twice as much as bitcoin.

items.title: Bitcoin mining pool once handling 2.3% of network shuts after hashrate falls 65%
items.summary: Computing power directed at Binance Pool has fallen from 26 EH/s in December to about 9 EH/s. Its remaining miners must choose another provider before a Nov. 10 cutoff.

items.title: Bitcoin wilts as Fed rate uncertainty weighs. Kospi plunges 8%
items.summary: Bets on an October Fed rate hike briefly spiked to nearly 50% after Wednesday’s inflation report, but have since cooled.

items.title: HEX token sellers erase $160M following reports of founder Richard Schueler arrest
items.summary: The HEX token’s price declined by 30% following local media reports of the Istanbul arrest of founder Richard Schueler, nearly two years after Interpol issued a “Red Notice.”

items.title: Ledger’s answer to wallet tampering costs $849 and ships next year
items.summary: Ledger’s new Atom combines crypto wallet security with everyday apps and is expected to ship in summer 2027 as the company investigates tampered wallets sold in Asia.

items.title: White House crypto council chief Patrick Witt steps down
items.summary: Witt’s departure leaves a leadership gap at the White House Crypto Council and marks the fourth high-profile exit from the advisory group.

items.title: Bitget, Liquid exploits push Q3 crypto hacks toward $1.2B
items.summary: Compromised suppliers, developer tools and infrastructure components outside security audits drove about 77% of the quarter’s total losses, according to Hacken.

items.title: Bitcoin dips to $80.1K as KOSPI closes at its lowest since April
items.summary: Bitcoin price action continued to see contagion from a Korean tech sell-off after the KOSPI Index fell 7.5% on Thursday.
